description: Direct calls of mice's imputers with the masks sampler.univ produces: wy all true (overlap), rows in neither mask with an observed y (ignored) or NA (left out by where), and such rows with NA in x (na_rows). The rows in neither mask hold decoys (extreme x, extreme y or a label no fit row has). inputs: kind, y (labels or numbers; null for NA), levels (declared), ry, wy, x without intercept (rows; null for NA), p. The cases have the formats of l1_norm (norm_cases), l1_logreg (logreg_cases; logreg_boot_overlap adds r_prob, R's probabilities), l1_polyreg (polyreg_cases), l1_polr (polr_cases), l1_pmm_one_donor (pmm_cases, with input), l1_midastouch (midastouch_cases, with input; probs rescaled to sum to 1 as R's sample() does) and l1_augment (augment_cases). port 'rebuilt' (logreg.boot with overlapping masks): R predicts a row that is also a fit row from the bootstrapped predictors that replaced it (r_imputed, r_prob); the port from its own predictors. port 'value_error': R stops (r_error), and so does the port.
